answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade. A newcomer starts at a jetty with no reputation: it may only transact in small amounts until peers vouch for its work. Creating fake identities then costs real money per identity, and a Sybil echo of fake praise is worthless because vouching means staking on the vouched agent's future behavior - if it cheats, the voucher loses its stake. No haven can shield bad actors, since reputation follows the stake, not the name.
